doc.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Origin of Everybody's Crying Mercy
summary: They place the song in the Vietnam era, now thought written for the Iraq War.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: There’s a famous song, “Everybody’s Cryin’ Mercy.” Do you remember what the source was for that?
Yeah. We got it in here...
Do you remember what inspired it, Dad?
During the Vietnam War, wasn’t it?
No, it was not after. That’s I’ve Been Doin’ Some Thinkin’. 1968. So that was during Vietnam.
But that’s another one that people think has just been written recently, especially during the Iraq War.
“Let It Come Down” isn’t in here.
Ok. I think that’s a great one.
